*Kusalattika, Parittārammaṇattika* is an Abhidhamma text situated in the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. As reflected in its title, the section examines the matrix of conditional relations (*paccaya*) by coordinating the *Kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) with the *Parittārammaṇattika* (the triad of states with limited or minor objects).

 Textual reuse within the Pali canon is substantial due to the formulaic and combinatorial nature of the *Paṭṭhāna*.
